title: 2017 Topps Star Wars The Last Jedi - The Resistance Takes Flight Red #84
descriptionText: The product is a 2017 Topps Star Wars The Last Jedi trading card featuring The Resistance Takes Flight Red #84. It is part of the Star Wars: Journey to The Last Jedi set, manufactured by Topps in the United States. This trading card is a collectible item within the Star Wars franchise, specifically tied to the Star Wars: Resistance TV show. The red parallel/variety adds a unique element to the card, making it a sought-after item for fans and collectors alike.
